fields.name: format
fields.description: Specify the data format to be used in the HTTP request body. Supported formats: json, json_stream, json_lines, gelf, msgpack.

fields.name: header
fields.description: Add a HTTP header key/value pair. Multiple headers can be set.

fields.name: host
fields.description: IP address or hostname of the target WebSocket Server.

fields.name: json_date_format
fields.description: Specify the format of the date. Supported formats: double, epoch, epoch_ms, iso8601, java_sql_timestamp.

fields.name: json_date_key
fields.description: Specify the name of the date field in output.

fields.name: port
fields.description: TCP port of the target WebSocket Server.

fields.name: uri
fields.description: Specify an optional HTTP URI for the target WebSocket server. For example, /someuri.

fields.name: workers
fields.description: The number of workers to perform flush operations for this output.

fields.name: match
fields.description: Tag match pattern used to route records to this plugin. Supports '*' wildcard matching.

fields.name: match_regex
fields.description: Regular expression tag match used to route records to this plugin. Takes precedence over match when both are set.
